responsibility: Provides the Xtensa machine description: the RTL patterns, attributes, reservations, splits, and peepholes that describe the target instruction set to GCC. It defines unspec codes and scheduling attributes, includes the Xtensa predicates and constraints files, and then gives the recognizers and output templates for arithmetic, loads/stores, control flow, calls, atomics, floating point, hardware loops, and post-reload cleanups, making it the central declarative specification that converts RTL into concrete Xtensa instructions.
same_name_distinction: Among the xtensa.* files, this is the machine description in .md form: it declares unspecs, attributes, pipeline reservations, instruction patterns, splits, and peepholes used by RTL generation/recognition, rather than the C++ hook code in xtensa.cc, the target macros in xtensa.h, or the option declarations in xtensa.opt.
